findings.name: future_availability_conditions_present_features
findings.observation: The v2 builder joins future targets before computing cross-item percentile features. V3 derives its market-return factor from that filtered frame.
findings.verification: Source inspection and isolated in-memory SQL reproduction of the join/rank sequence.
findings.reproduction: Two current items had rank features 0 and 1. Removing only the first item's future row changed the second item's current rank from 1 to 0, with current history unchanged.

findings.name: global_timestamp_masks_item_staleness
findings.observation: The serving path assigns the newest timestamp across items to every item.
findings.verification: Controlled serving-clock reproduction using saved local artifacts, not today's live UI.

findings.name: inference_reads_labelled_training_rows
findings.observation: V3 serves each item's latest labelled training-parquet row, which requires a future four-hour bar to exist.

findings.name: displayed_score_not_independently_evaluated
findings.observation: The served probability/volatility ranking differs from the raw scores in the historical evaluator. Calibration-slice diagnostics are not independent holdout evidence.
findings.verification: Source inspection of serving, evaluation and training paths.

conclusion: Historical exploratory scores need revalidation after point-in-time feature and serving fixes before supporting current ranking or profitability claims.
limits: This export summarizes the owning project's audit and preserves its evidence levels.
The portfolio integrator independently inspected the future-join/rank ordering and global timestamp source, but did not rerun the saved-artifact reproduction.
No inflation estimate, new training, live UI acceptance, profitable trading claim or application-code repair is represented.
